title: A 70-foot land dispute turned ugly as Louisiana neighbours traded signs, lights and a dead cow
summary_full: Two Louisiana neighbouring families spent years arguing over a disputed 70-foot strip of land. The conflict escalated after one family put up large “NO TRESPASSING” signs, bright lights, loud generators and even a dead cow near the boundary. A Louisiana appeals court upheld the old fence as the property line and affirmed $15,000 in damages and a permanent injunction.
